meta.title: Changing a chosen template asks before it discards sheet data
warnings: the QA memory is not built, so the plan was written without it — run `npm run rag:build`

steps.note: Open the multi-stage create screen for the template-change scenario.
Provide the required event title for the create flow.
Choose the initial template whose sheet will be populated.
Add a line item so the pricing sheet has editable data.
Populate the sheet to establish the data that must survive cancellation and be discarded on confirmation.

args.goal: select a different offered template, verify the confirmation says "Do you really want to change the template?", cancel it and prove the original sheet values remain, then select the different template again, confirm the change, and prove the old sheet data is gone while the new template columns are present; stop on the changed sheet

steps.note: Directly exercises and observes both cancel and confirm branches, which no catalog domain step models.
Assert the create screen remains healthy after both template-change branches.
